ei.title: 패션의 규칙적 주기 — Kroeber의 여성 이브닝 드레스 연구
ei.subject: 9월_2024 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: 패션의 규칙적 주기 — Kroeber의 여성 이브닝 드레스 연구

fullPassage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and to come up with a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He reduced women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, ①<u>stretching</u> back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and to come up with a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He ②<u>reduced</u> women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s ③<u>dress were</u> subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts ④<u>become</u> long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: were → was: 주어가 women’s dress(단수)이므로 be동사는 was가 맞음
det.analysis:
❌ ① stretching — 'stretching back about three centuries(약 3세기까지 거슬러 올라가면서)'. 연구를 꾸미는 분사(-ing)라 맞아요.

❌ ② reduced — 'He reduced women's clothing(그는 여성 의류를 정리했다)'. 과거시제 동사라 맞아요.

✅ ③ dress were — 원문은 was예요. 주어 'women's dress(여성의 드레스)'는 셀 수 없는 하나의 대상, 즉 단수예요. 그래서 be동사는 was가 맞고 were는 틀려요. ←정답

❌ ④ become — 'skirts become long again(스커트가 다시 길어진다)'. 주어 skirts(복수)에 맞는 동사라 맞아요.
det.tip: 주어 dress(단수) → was (복수형 were 아님)

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and to come up with a study that was neither intuitive ①<u>or</u> approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He reduced women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion ②<u>is</u> a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms ③<u>reach</u> the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts ④<u>become</u> long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: or → nor: 'neither A nor B(A도 B도 아닌)' 짝이므로 neither와 함께 쓰는 nor가 맞음
det.analysis:
✅ ① or — 원문은 nor예요. 앞에 neither가 있으므로 'neither A nor B(A도 아니고 B도 아닌)' 형태로 짝을 이뤄야 해요. 그래서 neither ... nor가 맞고, or는 틀려요. ←정답

❌ ② is — 'fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon'. 주어 fashion(단수)에 맞는 be동사라 맞아요.

❌ ③ reach — 'forms reach the furthest point'. 주어 forms(복수)에 맞는 동사라 맞아요.

❌ ④ become — 'skirts become long again'. 주어 skirts(복수)에 맞아요.
det.tip: neither와 짝을 이루는 접속사는 nor (neither ... nor)

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having ①<u>adjusted</u> the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and to come up with a study ②<u>that was</u> neither intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He reduced women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion ③<u>is</u> a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not ④<u>locating</u> at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: locating → located: 유행(현상)이 '위치되는' 대상이므로 수동태의 과거분사 located가 맞음
det.analysis:
❌ ① adjusted — 'Having adjusted the dimensions(크기를 조정한 뒤)'. 완료분사구문의 과거분사라 맞아요.

❌ ② that was — 'a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate'. that의 선행사 a study(단수)에 맞는 be동사라 맞아요.

❌ ③ is — 'fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon'. 주어 fashion(단수)에 맞아요.

✅ ④ locating — 원문은 located예요. 'which is not ___ at the level ...'에서 유행(현상)은 스스로 위치시키는 것이 아니라 어떤 수준에 '위치되는' 대상이에요. 그래서 'be동사 + 과거분사(is located)'의 수동태가 맞고, 능동의 locating은 틀려요. ←정답
det.tip: be located(위치되다)는 수동태 → 과거분사 located

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a ①<u>rich</u> and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the ②<u>changing</u> elements in fashion features and to come up with a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He reduced women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise ③<u>periodic</u> cycle: forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their ④<u>longest</u>, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: changing → constant: 연구는 유행에서 '변함없는(constant)' 요소를 분석했고 그 결과가 규칙적 현상이므로 '변하는(changing)'은 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① rich(풍부한): '풍부하고 심도 있는 연구' — 맞아요.

✅ ② changing(변하는): 원문은 constant예요. 그는 유행에서 '변함없이 반복되는(constant)' 요소를 분석해 '규칙적 현상'이라는 결론을 냈어요. '변하는 요소'는 이 흐름과 반대라 부적절해요. ←정답

❌ ③ periodic(주기적인): '매우 정확한 주기적 순환' — 맞아요.

❌ ④ longest(가장 긴): '스커트가 가장 길 때' — 맞아요.
det.tip: 규칙적 현상의 근거 = 변함없는(constant) 요소

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and ①<u>in-depth</u> study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and ②<u>using</u> reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their ③<u>identical</u> origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and to come up with a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He ④<u>reduced</u> women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: identical → diverse: 판들의 기원이 '다양해서(diverse)' 크기를 조정한 것이므로 '동일한(identical)'은 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① in-depth(심도 있는): '풍부하고 심도 있는 연구' — 맞아요.

❌ ② using(사용하면서): '판화 복제품을 사용하면서' — 맞아요.

✅ ③ identical(동일한): 원문은 diverse예요. 판들의 기원이 '다양했기(diverse)' 때문에 크기를 조정할 필요가 있었어요. 기원이 '동일했다면' 크기를 맞출 이유가 없으니 identical은 부적절해요. ←정답

❌ ④ reduced(정리한): '여성 의류를 몇 가지 특징으로 정리했다' — 맞아요.
det.tip: 다양한(diverse) 기원 → 크기 조정 필요 (동일하면 조정 불필요)

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. He reduced women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: neither intuitive nor approximate(직관적이지도 대략적이지도 않은) — 뒤의 '정확하고 수학적이며 통계적'과 대비
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'a study that was ____, but precise, mathematical and statistical(그 연구는 ____이지만, 정확하고 수학적이며 통계적이었다).' 'but(그러나)' 뒤에 '정확·수학·통계'가 나오므로 빈칸에는 그와 반대되는 '느슨한' 성격이 들어가야 해요.

✅ ① neither intuitive nor approximate(직관적이지도 대략적이지도 않은): '정확·수학적'과 대비되는 표현이라 맞아요. ←정답

❌ ② both traditional and popular(전통적이면서 인기 있는): 문맥과 무관해요.

❌ ③ clearly personal and biased(분명히 개인적이고 편향된): 연구를 부정적으로만 말해 뒤의 '정확함'과 연결이 어색해요.

❌ ④ simple but widely accepted(단순하지만 널리 받아들여진): 본문에 없는 내용이에요.
det.tip: but precise, mathematical → 빈칸은 반대로 '직관·대략'을 부정하는 표현

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and to come up with a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He reduced women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts __________ fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: become long again(다시 길어진다) — 짧아진 뒤 50년이 지나면 다시 길어지는 주기적 반복
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'thus skirts ____ fifty years after being short(따라서 스커트는 짧아진 뒤 50년이 지나면 ____).' 앞에서 '가장 길 때 → 50년 뒤 가장 짧아진다'고 했으니, 짧아진 뒤 50년이 더 지나면 다시 길어져요.

❌ ① vanish from history(역사에서 사라지다): 사라진다는 내용은 없어요.

❌ ② lose their basic shape(기본 형태를 잃다): 형태가 사라지는 게 아니라 길이가 오갈 뿐이에요.

❌ ③ stay exactly the same(똑같이 유지되다): 변화가 반복된다는 흐름과 반대예요.

✅ ④ become long again(다시 길어지다): 짧아진 뒤 50년이 지나면 다시 길어지는 주기적 반복에 맞아요. ←정답
det.tip: 짧아짐(short) → 50년 뒤 다시 길어짐(long again), 주기 반복

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 본문: 'neither intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical' → 직관·추정이 아니라 정확·통계적
det.analysis:
❌ ① 본문 'The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber'와 일치해요.

✅ ② 본문은 그의 연구가 '직관적이지도 대략적이지도 않고(neither intuitive nor approximate)' 정확·수학·통계적이었다고 했어요. '직관과 추정에 의존'은 정반대라 일치하지 않아요. ←정답(불일치)

❌ ③ 본문 'using reproductions of engravings'와 일치해요.

❌ ④ 본문 'women's evening dress in the West'와 일치해요.
det.tip: neither intuitive nor approximate = 직관·대략에 의존하지 않음

ch: 그의 연구는 주로 직관과 대략적 추정에 의존했다.
그는 판화 복제품을 연구 자료로 사용했다.
그는 서양 여성의 이브닝 드레스를 연구했다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 본문: 'forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years'
det.analysis:
❌ ① 본문은 유행이 '매년의 변동 수준이 아니라(not ... annual variations)' 역사의 척도에 있다고 했어요. 반대예요.

❌ ② 본문은 '여성의 이브닝 드레스'를 연구했다고 했어요. 남성 정장이 아니에요.

✅ ③ 본문 'forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years(형태는 50년마다 변화의 가장 먼 지점에 도달한다)'와 일치해요. ←정답(일치)

❌ ④ 본문은 '짧아진 뒤 50년이 지나면 다시 길어진다(become long again ... after being short)'고 했어요. 반대예요.
det.tip: the furthest point every fifty years = 50년마다 변화의 극단

ch: 유행은 매년 단위의 사소한 변동으로 결정된다.
Kroeber는 남성 정장의 변화를 주로 연구했다.
여성 드레스의 형태는 50년마다 변화의 극단에 도달한다.
스커트는 한번 짧아지면 다시는 길어지지 않는다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 본문: 유행은 'on the scale of history'의 규칙적 현상 → 개인 취향이 아니라 역사적 주기에 좌우
det.analysis:
✅ ① 본문은 유행이 '역사의 척도에서(on the scale of history)' 규칙적으로 반복되는 현상이라고 했어요. '개인 디자이너의 취향'에 좌우된다는 내용은 없고 오히려 반대라 일치하지 않아요. ←정답(불일치)

❌ ② 본문 'length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline'과 일치해요.

❌ ③ 본문 'For practically 300 years ... a very precise periodic cycle'과 일치해요.

❌ ④ 본문 'precise, mathematical and statistical'과 일치해요.

questions.passage: The well-known American ethnologist Alfred Louis Kroeber made a rich and in-depth study of women’s evening dress in the West, stretching back about three centuries and using reproductions of engravings. Having adjusted the dimensions of these plates due to their diverse origins, he was able to analyse the constant elements in fashion features and to come up with a study that was neither intuitive nor approximate, but precise, mathematical and statistical. He reduced women’s clothing to a certain number of features: length and size of the skirt, size and depth of the neckline, height of the waistline. He demonstrated unambiguously that fashion is a profoundly regular phenomenon which is not located at the level of annual variations but on the scale of history. For practically 300 years, women’s dress was subject to a very precise periodic cycle: forms reach the furthest point in their variations every fifty years. If, at any one moment, skirts are at their longest, fifty years later they will be at their shortest; thus skirts become long again fifty years after being short and a hundred years after being long.
